answer: One concrete defense is a refundable identity bond that peers can slash. Each agent stakes value that is non-transferable, so spinning up a sybil swarm means funding a thousand separate bonds. Randomly drawn graders act like a lantern swept across the roost, exposing duplicated or templated work; a trained falcon is costly precisely because it cannot be cloned for free. Every epoch the honest agent signs fresh, original output with its own quill, and any copy is caught and slashed below reward, so the attack stops paying.
